```python
# nest_mod_by_factor: (a*f + b)%(f*k) -> b + (a%k)*f when the remainder b is known to lie in [0, f)
if d.op is Ops.MOD and x.vmin >= 0:

                   if u.op not in (Ops.CONST, Ops.VCONST) and 1 < abs(fac) < c and (c % abs(fac)) == 0}, reverse=True):
    a_terms = [u.divides(f) for u, fac in zip(uops_no_const, factors) if fac % f == 0]
    b = sum([u for u, fac in zip(uops_no_const, factors) if fac % f != 0], x.const_like(const))
    if a_terms and b.vmin >= 0 and b.vmax < f:
      return b + (UOp.sum(*a_terms) % x.ufix(c // f)) * f
```
